blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA—For team captain Jia De Guzman, the road to volleyball greatness is about building a program that consistently faces the world’s best and learns from them. After Alas Pilipinas vented its frustration on Qatar with a 25‑8, 25‑2, 25‑9 rout to notch its first win at the Asian Games 2026 here, De Guzman made it clear that the team’s future hinges on more games against powerhouse squads and sustained international exposure. “In every game that we played so far, we’re starting to see the things we need to improve […]...
